other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
The applicant’s registration must be renewed annually.
Parent(s) must be registered members with active membership in the Jammu & Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The child must be a regular student and attend regularly.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 per student, with amounts varying by education level (₹4,500 for classes 9‑10, ₹6,000 for classes 11‑12, ₹10,000 for undergraduate, ₹15,000 for postgraduate).
